title: Option Period and Signing Deposit Terms — Group Room Blocks
content:
For each Group Room Blocks type the contract schedule fixes three signing terms: the option period (the calendar days after the proposal is issued within which the organiser must sign, after which the tentative block lapses), whether the signing deposit must be received for the contract to be signed, and the calendar days after the proposal within which the signing deposit is due.

| Block type | Option period (calendar days after the proposal) | Signing deposit must be received for the contract to be signed | Signing deposit due (calendar days after the proposal) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Social Event Room Block | 14 | Yes | 7 |
| Wedding Room Block | 14 | Yes | 7 |
| Sports Team Room Block | 7 | Yes | 3 |
| Tour & Travel Series Block | 21 | No | 0 |
| Corporate Meeting Room Block | 14 | No | 0 |
| Association Convention Room Block | 30 | No | 0 |

### Notes to the schedule

- Both periods run from the date the proposal was issued and are counted in calendar days.
- The three block types that do not require the signing deposit for signature show 0 days in the due column.
- The signing deposit period is shorter than the option period for every block type that requires the deposit: 7 against 14 days for social events and weddings, 3 against 7 days for sports teams.

### Illustration (hypothetical dates)

A Sports Team Room Block proposal is issued on a given day. On this schedule the signing deposit falls due within 3 calendar days of that day and the option period runs for 7 calendar days from it. A Tour & Travel Series Block proposal issued the same day carries a 21-day option period and no signing-deposit requirement for signature.
